svg.font-family: JetBrains Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
svg.aria-label: A floating waybar of frosted pills: workspaces, the window title, Tannoy's song, then the lamps, where Waybill's dot is dim. In a terminal an agent runs waybill ask with two options for a launch discount, and the dot turns amber with a 1 beside it. A click opens the Waybill drawer out of it: three tasks wait on you, the decision first with its options as buttons, then a foley recording and a backup disk to swap, over a sparkline of the week's finished tasks. A click on the first option writes the ruling: the decision leaves the drawer, the lamp goes dim, and in the terminal the agent's waybill next starts that task with the ruling on it as a visit. A click outside closes the drawer.

g.text: ● The launch needs a discount, and that call is yours.
--option "No offer at launch" -- "Pick the launch discount"
Asked Me: Pick the launch discount
● Filed. I'll take something else until you rule.
visit Me: 10% for the first week
